title: Frame rate cadence payload
summary: JSON Schema for the cadence payload - nominal, average and effective fps, duplicate ratio, cadence name, hold pattern, VFR flag and interval statistics.
description: Emitted as the envelope payload by video_re_detect_frame_rate_cadence; the envelope itself follows the baltor.video-detection/v1 schema.

review.notes: Valid example validates and invalid example fails (Draft 2020-12); the detector's tests validate every emitted payload against this schema.
